entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our convoy pulled up to the gates o..."
entries.dialogueText: Our convoy pulled up to the gates of the Public Cemetery in Erlory -- Petr's hometown. Monica and Deana were beside me in the car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked numb and empty. Deana..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked numb and empty. Deana appeared to be deep in thought.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“But how did Uncle Petr die? Why wo..."
entries.dialogueText: “But how did Uncle Petr die? Why won't anyone tell me?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He killed himself, Deana.""
entries.dialogueText: “He killed himself, Deana."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Monica looked like she was about to..."
entries.dialogueText: Monica looked like she was about to cry.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“It doesn't matter, sweetheart.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It doesn't matter, sweetheart.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She turned her head to look out the..."
entries.dialogueText: She turned her head to look out the window, hiding her tears.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Papa? Tell me the truth!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Papa? Tell me the truth!”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""He... fell. It was an accident.""
entries.dialogueText: "He... fell. It was an accident."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“You will understand when you are o..."
entries.dialogueText: “You will understand when you are older.”
entries.menuText: “You will understand when you are older.”

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“But... but why?""
entries.dialogueText: “But... but why?"

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Like when I fall off my bike?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Like when I fall off my bike?”

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“That's not fair. I'm almost 12.""
entries.dialogueText: “That's not fair. I'm almost 12."

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Anton! She is still too young.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Anton! She is still too young.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't sugar-coat reality for her..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't sugar-coat reality for her forever, Monica."
entries.menuText: "I can't sugar-coat reality for her forever, Monica."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Your mother is right, Deana. Sorry..."
entries.dialogueText: “Your mother is right, Deana. Sorry.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“It's better to remember Uncle Petr..."
entries.dialogueText: “It's better to remember Uncle Petr by the way he lived, not by the way he died."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I did not reply. Deana looked as co..."
entries.dialogueText: I did not reply. Deana looked as confused as she had before.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: ""No, honey. Nothing like that.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, honey. Nothing like that."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: "“We have arrived, Mr. President.”"
entries.dialogueText: “We have arrived, Mr. President.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The driver's window rolled down."
entries.dialogueText: The driver's window rolled down.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Serge went outside and opened our d..."
entries.dialogueText: Serge went outside and opened our door. As soon as we stepped out, camera flashes went off.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evelyn Vectern was waiting for us...."
entries.dialogueText: Evelyn Vectern was waiting for us. Upon seeing her, Monica ran up to her and they hugged.

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Evelyn. I'm so sorry. How are you..."
entries.dialogueText: “Evelyn. I'm so sorry. How are you holding up?”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“So-so. It's hard to play the berea..."
entries.dialogueText: “So-so. It's hard to play the bereaved widow, knowing the kind of man he really was."

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“But still. We were married almost..."
entries.dialogueText: “But still. We were married almost 20 years, Monica.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They hugged once again. Evelyn wipe..."
entries.dialogueText: They hugged once again. Evelyn wiped her tears and patted Deana on the head before turning to me.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“And the way he died...It's just to..."
entries.dialogueText: “And the way he died...It's just too...sudden.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“My condolences.”"
entries.dialogueText: “My condolences.”

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I hugged her. She took my hands in..."
entries.dialogueText: I hugged her. She took my hands in hers as she pulled back.

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“Thank you, Anton.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you, Anton.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“I know there's nothing either of u..."
entries.dialogueText: “I know there's nothing either of us could have done. But I still can't help feeling responsible for this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“I can't believe he's gone.”"
entries.dialogueText: “I can't believe he's gone.”

entries.speaker: Evelyn Vectern
entries.title: Evelyn Vectern: "“All right. Let's go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “All right. Let's go.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The four of us -- Evelyn, Monica, D..."
entries.dialogueText: The four of us -- Evelyn, Monica, Deana and I -- took our places towards the front of the crowd.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From afar, we heard the sound of mi..."
entries.dialogueText: From afar, we heard the sound of military boots approaching. A soldier was leading a group with a large framed photo of Petr in his hands.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Behind him followed other soldiers,..."
entries.dialogueText: Behind him followed other soldiers, marching alongside a cart with a carved goat on the front.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On top of the cart, wrapped in a So..."
entries.dialogueText: On top of the cart, wrapped in a Sordish flag, was the coffin of Petr Vectern. The Fourth Vice President of Sordland.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The group stopped in front of us. T..."
entries.dialogueText: The group stopped in front of us. They lifted the coffin up off the cart and laid it down on a platform.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One of the soldiers took the flag,..."
entries.dialogueText: One of the soldiers took the flag, folded it and presented it to me. I walked behind the podium to deliver my speech.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The crowd was sparse -- Petr hadn't..."
entries.dialogueText: The crowd was sparse -- Petr hadn't had many friends left by the end. His father and brothers lifted the coffin on their shoulders and brought it to the grave.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The priest completed his ceremony...."
entries.dialogueText: The priest completed his ceremony. It was time for me to make a speech.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Today, we mourn Petr Vectern. The..."
entries.dialogueText: “Today, we mourn Petr Vectern. The Fourth Vice President of Sordland and...”
entries.menuText: “Today, we mourn Petr Vectern. The Fourth Vice President of Sordland and...”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“...a true Sord who strived to achi..."
entries.dialogueText: “...a true Sord who strived to achieve the best for his country against all odds.”
entries.menuText: “...a true Sord who strived to achieve the best for his country against all odds.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“...a very successful statesman wit..."
entries.dialogueText: “...a very successful statesman with whom I worked very closely over many years."
entries.menuText: “...a very successful statesman with whom I worked very closely over many years."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“...my brother. Our bond was not a..."
entries.dialogueText: “...my brother. Our bond was not a bond of blood. It was something stronger. It was a bond of friendship and camaraderie.”
entries.menuText: “...my brother. Our bond was not a bond of blood. It was something stronger. It was a bond of friendship and camaraderie.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“He was there with me from the very..."
entries.dialogueText: “He was there with me from the very beginning. He swore he would support our cause until the end.”
entries.menuText: “He was there with me from the very beginning. He swore he would support our cause until the end.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“God's word says no man can be perf..."
entries.dialogueText: “God's word says no man can be perfect. And Petr was certainly no exception.”
entries.menuText: “God's word says no man can be perfect. And Petr was certainly no exception.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We drank together. Cried together...."
entries.dialogueText: “We drank together. Cried together. Laughed together. Fought together.”
entries.menuText: “We drank together. Cried together. Laughed together. Fought together.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Though we did not always see eye t..."
entries.dialogueText: “Though we did not always see eye to eye, I owe Petr everything. I wouldn't be President if not for him.”
entries.menuText: “Though we did not always see eye to eye, I owe Petr everything. I wouldn't be President if not for him.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Despite his unconscionable actions..."
entries.dialogueText: “Despite his unconscionable actions towards the very end of his life, I choose to remember him as he was.”
entries.menuText: “Despite his unconscionable actions towards the very end of his life, I choose to remember him as he was.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“We must all remember him not at hi..."
entries.dialogueText: “We must all remember him not at his worst, but for the good deeds he has done."
entries.menuText: “We must all remember him not at his worst, but for the good deeds he has done."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The path he paved will go down in..."
entries.dialogueText: “The path he paved will go down in history.”
entries.menuText: “The path he paved will go down in history.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Never before Sordland had a Vice P..."
entries.dialogueText: “Never before Sordland had a Vice President like Petr. Never again will it."
entries.menuText: “Never before Sordland had a Vice President like Petr. Never again will it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“The past is past. We must always l..."
entries.dialogueText: “The past is past. We must always look to the future. That's what he would've wanted.”
entries.menuText: “The past is past. We must always look to the future. That's what he would've wanted.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Thank you.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Thank you.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Farewell brother. You will be miss..."
entries.dialogueText: “Farewell brother. You will be missed.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Morning shall come!”"
entries.dialogueText: “Morning shall come!”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the crowd yelled: "Vict..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the crowd yelled: "Victory is close!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Amid the applause, I went back to j..."
entries.dialogueText: Amid the applause, I went back to join Monica and Deana.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I walked past Evelyn, she mouthe..."
entries.dialogueText: As I walked past Evelyn, she mouthed the words: "Thank you".

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Trumpets cut through the silence. S..."
entries.dialogueText: Trumpets cut through the silence. Stern-looking soldiers formed a line and held their rifles in front.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "One after another, ten shots rang o..."
entries.dialogueText: One after another, ten shots rang out. With each shot, I shuddered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I felt a tug on my left arm."
entries.dialogueText: I felt a tug on my left arm.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The priest's voice cut through the..."
entries.dialogueText: The priest's voice cut through the silence. Everyone joined in the prayer he was chanting.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Looking at the coffin, I shuddered."
entries.dialogueText: Looking at the coffin, I shuddered.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The coffin started to be lowered in..."
entries.dialogueText: The coffin started to be lowered into the grave.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Are you crying?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Are you crying?”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I had known Petr for almost 30 year..."
entries.dialogueText: I had known Petr for almost 30 years. The time we spent together flashed back before my eyes. The good memories and bad ones. All of it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It didn't matter anymore. He was go..."
entries.dialogueText: It didn't matter anymore. He was gone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Surprised, I checked my face. My ey..."
entries.dialogueText: Surprised, I checked my face. My eyes were wet.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“It's raining.”"
entries.dialogueText: “It's raining.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Yes.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Yes.”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“No, I'm not.”"
entries.dialogueText: “No, I'm not.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked up to the sky."
entries.dialogueText: She looked up to the sky.

entries.speaker: Deana
entries.title: Deana: "“Papa, it's not raini-.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Papa, it's not raini-.”

entries.speaker: Monica
entries.title: Monica: "“Come on Deana. Let's go.”"
entries.dialogueText: “Come on Deana. Let's go.”

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hugged my leg."
entries.dialogueText: She hugged my leg.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The coffin was fully lowered and th..."
entries.dialogueText: The coffin was fully lowered and the tombstone placed. The crowd began dispersing.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I left a bottle on the grave. Erlor..."
entries.dialogueText: I left a bottle on the grave. Erlory 30-year-old. His favorite.
entries.menuText: Leave a bottle of whiskey on the grave.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I left as well."
entries.dialogueText: I left as well.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I stayed there by myself for anothe..."
entries.dialogueText: I stayed there by myself for another half hour.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun finally set after painting..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun finally set after painting the sky blood red.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our convoy pulled up to the gates o..."
entries.dialogueText: Our convoy pulled up to the gates of the National Cemetery in Erlorly -- Petr's hometown. Monica and Deana were beside me in the car.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The news of Petr's death had hit Fr..."
entries.dialogueText: The news of Petr's death had hit Franc especially hard. Rather than attend the funeral, he had taken a few days off from school to have time to himself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The news of Petr's death had hit Fr..."
entries.dialogueText: The news of Petr's death had hit Franc especially hard. Rather than attend the funeral, he had taken a few days of personal leave from the army to have time to himself.

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""My deepest condolences. I know you..."
entries.dialogueText: "My deepest condolences. I know you and Mr. Vectern were very close."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thank you, Serge.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Serge."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We weren't at the end.""
entries.dialogueText: "We weren't at the end."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You're right. We were.""
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. We were."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I know what you mean.""
entries.dialogueText: "I know what you mean."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's not your fault, Evelyn.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not your fault, Evelyn."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You shouldn't feel guilty. And nei..."
entries.dialogueText: "You shouldn't feel guilty. And neither should I."
entries.menuText: "You shouldn't feel guilty. And neither should I."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Evelyn swallowed hard. Her eyes fil..."
entries.dialogueText: Evelyn swallowed hard. Her eyes filled with resolve.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It didn't matter anymore. He was go..."
entries.dialogueText: It didn't matter anymore. He was gone. Because of me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I reached over to give Monica a hug..."
entries.dialogueText: I reached over to give Monica a hug.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I wrapped an arm around my daughter..."
entries.dialogueText: I wrapped an arm around my daughter.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I sat there, silent."
entries.dialogueText: I sat there, silent.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She recoiled at my touch."
entries.dialogueText: She recoiled at my touch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She hugged me back tightly."
entries.dialogueText: She hugged me back tightly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The four of us -- Evelyn, Monica, D..."
entries.dialogueText: The four of us -- Evelyn, Monica, Deana and I -- took our places in front of the Vectern family plot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The sun finally set after painting..."
entries.dialogueText: The sun finally set after painting the sky blood red.
